verdict.rationale: Cua documents programmatic, non-interactive operation: a CLI and SDK in Python, TypeScript and Rust to create and drive computers from code, Docker/Podman/QEMU backends with any OCI image, `cua runtime setup` for host provisioning, one-command Cua Bench runs, and daemon-fired routines with unattended access. It does not, however, explicitly document CI pipelines or a headless mode, and a community user asked for an ephemeral one-shot VM mode specifically for CI, which suggests that workflow was not first-class. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs, a documented ephemeral one-shot run mode, independent hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.
